sentences.text: The old tales say that when the harvest comet burns green across the Irish sky, the creeping blossom wakes.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: A shepherd walked the misty river bank while strange purple moss withered beneath his heavy boots.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: In the smooth dark water of the pool, a giant flower with five golden eyes and a ring-toothed mouth showed its face long before it reached the shore.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Root-vines crawled silently from shadow to shadow, leaving the grass bleached white and the stones burning warm to the touch.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: The shepherd turned as a wet rustling sound filled the dark air behind him.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: A sudden crushing snap echoed through the silent hills as the bloom struck.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Only a dropped crook remained by the white grass, and the shepherd was simply never seen again.
sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.text: Would you follow the warm stones to find him?
sentences.speaker: narrator
